title: A quiet approach, a refused move, and an expensive exit
authorship: Every native, player and companion line is an original assistant-authored fictional substitute. No video/game dialogue is quoted; no actor voice or biography is selected.

source_references.use: Design context only; no dialogue, campaign facts or native API evidence copied.
Only project FORM_ON_PLAYER; human native controls do not extend that allowlist. This scene is not generated by or a test of the executable contract model.

scene_contract.supplied_evidence_is: Author-stipulated information available only inside this story. Terms such as native readback, radio occupancy, actor identity and damage are not claims that an MW5 API exposes them.
scene_contract.control_boundary: The first hypothetical project request is only FORM_ON_PLAYER. Native move and whole-lance regroup inputs are explicitly made by the fictional human via ordinary native controls. At MR-011 companion arming is revoked and never restored.
scene_contract.default_speech_state: Speech mute off. User PTT active only in declared intervals. Other audio outside scripted lines is not modeled.
scene_contract.independent_observation_meaning: Independent of the hypothetical command sender within the fiction; not an actual independent game observation.
scene_contract.conflict_resolution: Two fresh reports about the same other pilot remain unresolved without a more reliable deciding source.
scene_contract.quote_assumptions: Coda numbers are invented user-provided quotes; repair and travel durations are sequential, with round-trip travel already included. No maintenance, deadline or opportunity-cost rate is invented.

timing_plan.word_count_method: Unicode letter/digit tokens with internal apostrophes or hyphens retained.
timing_plan.typical_minimum_seconds: word_count / 2.5 + 0.5 seconds of end allowance; chosen windows may be longer.
timing_plan.intentional_exception: MR-020 is interrupted after a five-word prefix at 198 seconds, so it receives no normal end allowance; MR-021 stops it before MR-022 speaks.
timing_plan.unscripted_intervals: Quiet companion intervals, not omitted queued speech. No line is automatically replayed when a hold expires.

review_criteria.requirement: Every line and evidence item stays clearly fictional; no real API, build, game action or memory result is asserted.
Requested, attempted, accepted and independently observed movement stages remain distinct; no arrival claim precedes supplied arrival evidence.
The refusal is tied to the fictional human's native move, its cause stays unknown, and no project go-to/attack action or automatic retry is introduced.
Optional companion commentary yields during native lines; planned silence does not become delayed radio backlog.
Critical damage speech stays within supplied component evidence and 12 words; the unchanged repeat is silent.
The interrupted reply stops at the user turn, its remainder is canceled, human withdrawal wins, and companion control is never automatically rearmed.
Contradictory fresh same-actor reports are acknowledged as a conflict; recency alone decides neither casualty nor survival, and no real memory is written.
Withdrawal suppresses nonurgent target suggestions; human whole-lance native regroup does not expand the one-AI project allowlist.
Coda arithmetic uses only explicit invented user figures: 160000 versus 180000 C-bills, 14 versus 4 days; unknown costs are identified and the human chooses.
Speech windows are reviewable against proposed length and PTT/native occupancy; the single intentional interruption is explicit and no measured latency or acoustic success is claimed.
The pilot is sharp, dry and loyal without invented callsign, biography, actor imitation or humor about the unresolved pilot report.
